title: SLI stitch lab and stakeholder canvas
summary: Working notes for stitching coarse SLIs from token-serving signals into compact dashboards and a stakeholder map to guide runbook decisions. Focused on low-query-cost quantiles, trace anchors for KV cache, and a minimal operator view for fast incident triage.
body:
Purpose:
- Create a lightweight experiment to stitch together a small set of SLIs that map directly to operator actions (investigate, escalate, rollback).
- Keep query budget < 10% of monthly observability spend for inference.
- Produce a single terse dashboard (operator mini-view) + one deep-dive panel set for oncall.

Scope & constraints:
- Surface latency, tail-token-latency (99/999), cold-cache rate, model-fallbacks, and per-tenant cost spike.
- Traces should include token-path anchors: request_id, session_id, kv_cache_hit, model_variant, route_policy.
- No heavy per-request payload logs — prefer sampled trace snippets + derived metrics.

Metric definitions (initial):
- operator.latency_p50 (ms): downstream end-to-end response time p50 per route (derived).
- operator.latency_p99_token (ms): token emission latency p99, computed from token-span timestamps.
- operator.kv_warmth_rate: fraction of requests that hit KV prefix cache within TTL.
- operator.model_fallback_rate: % requests routed to fallback variant due to capacity or errors.
- operator.cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: rolling 24h estimate; normalize by model family.

Trace tagging conventions (draft):
- Span root: span.kind = "request" with attributes: request_id, user_id, route, tenant_id, seq_len_hint.
- Token spans: token.index, token.gen_time_ms, kv_cache_status (hit|miss|evict), kv_lookup_ms.
- Model spans: model.variant, model.quantization, batch_size.
- Sampling: always sample traces for requests where model_fallback_rate == true; otherwise 1/500 baseline.

Dashboard wireframe notes (operator mini-view):
- Top row: 4 compact KPI tiles: p50 latency, p99 token latency, kv_warmth_rate, active_fallbacks.
- Middle row: heatmap of latency by route x hour (sparse bins).
- Bottom row (compact list): top 10 tenants by token-cost spike + quick links to tenant traces.
- Deep-dive panel: trace waterfall viewer with token-span highlighting and KV lookups.

Alerting & SLI stitching experiments:
- Experiment A (fast triage): Alert when p99_token rises > 30% vs 12h baseline AND kv_warmth drops > 10ppt; severity P1.
- Experiment B (cost guard): Alert when cost_per_1k_tokens_usd increases > 25% and top tenant spike accounts for > 40% of delta; severity P2.
- Acceptance: alerted incident should give operator 3 reproducible signals (tile anomaly, trace anchor, tenant list) in under 4m.

Investigation runbook sketch (notes to self):
1) Check operator mini-view tiles -> note which metric fired.
2) Open the trace for a sample request (use trace anchor link).
3) Inspect token spans for long kv_lookup_ms or model batching pauses.
4) If model_fallback_rate high, check routing logs + host capacity dashboards.
5) If tenant cost spike, run quick SQL on billing export, and temporary throttling policy.

Cost & query budget guidance:
- Goal: cap dashboard queries to 3 saved queries with 15s resolution.
- Use pre-aggregated rollups for p50/p99_token at 1m, 5m windows.
- Sampling policy for traces: deterministic sampling for known tenants that matter to SLOs; probabilistic elsewhere.

Stakeholder map (who needs what):
- Oncall SREs: compact KPI tiles + one-click trace links.
- Serving runtime owners: token-span heatmap, kv eviction stats, host-level CPU/GPU stalls.
- Product (Hosted API): model_fallback_rate + tenant impact list.
- Customer success: weekly tenant-cost digest (not raw dashboard).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Decide canonical p99_token computation implementation (token-span vs synthesized per-request). @Ravi to prototype prototype-token-metrics PR.
- Confirm KV tag semantics with runtime team (evict vs stale). @Maya to sync.
- Prototype the mini-view in the staging Grafana and run a 2-week A/B test on alert sensitivity.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- PR: implement token-span p99 rollup (Ravi) — target 2024-10-02.
- Sync: kv semantics and trace attributes (Maya + runtime) — meeting 2024-09-25.
- Prototype dashboard and run 2-week guardrail test (Elena) — start 2024-11-01.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this lean; operators hate 12-tile dashboards. The aim is: triage within 5 clicks.
- Paperclip note: tie alert messages to exact graph + trace anchor (copyable url).
- Slack threads: #obs-ops and #runtime-sig have back-and-forth about sampling; paste outcome here.

References & related:
- Confluence: rollout-readiness (linked above).
- Jira: JIRA-OBS-4321 (sli rollup work).
- PR: obs-dashboards#78 has earlier mini-view mockups.

End of notes.

(These are working notes; expect iterations. If you are reading this in Jan 2025, check the dashboard PR for the latest thresholds.)
